title: The Lemon and Aqua New Year's Day Brunch
description: A sunny New Year's Day brunch from Amazon: an aqua Dash mini waffle maker, a yellow gingham ruffle table runner, an acrylic Mimosa Bar sign, two glass juice carafes with chalkboard tags, lemon melamine plates and Happy New Year gold foil napkins.
intro: New Year's Day is the only morning all year nobody expects anything from me. So I make it count. Last year I made mini waffles for six people in that little aqua waffle maker, one waffle at a time, while everybody drank mimosas and told me to hurry up. Worth it. Now the yellow gingham runner goes down, the lemon plates come out, the carafes get filled, and the Mimosa Bar sign tells everyone to serve themselves. Brunch is the best part of the holiday. Fight me.

sections.heading: The waffle situation
paragraphs: An aqua Dash mini waffle maker with a 4-inch ceramic nonstick plate. It makes one small waffle at a time, which sounds slow until you realize everybody gets theirs hot. It's cute enough to leave out on the counter, too.

sections.heading: The mimosa bar
paragraphs: Two 1-liter glass carafes with lids and little chalkboard tags, one for orange juice and one for whatever else you've got. A clear acrylic Mimosa Bar sign (5 x 7 in, wood stand) tells everyone the rules: pour the bubbly, add some juice, top with fruit.

sections.heading: The table
paragraphs: A yellow gingham ruffle runner (13 x 72 in, cotton) and a set of 6 lemon melamine dinner plates (11 in) with soft lavender flowers around the edge. They don't break when the kids carry them. Black and white striped Happy New Year napkins with gold foil add the little sparkle.
